Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary United States Floating Wall Shelf - 28 x 18 x 4 Inch, Black Metal
Colors: Black
Materials: Stone
You'll have a tough time finding a more clever combination of wall art and storage solution. This set of black metal shelves in the shape of the United States will be a conversation starter along with a place to display small items or stash keys. 28.75" W x 18.5" H x 4.25" D Iron with black finish Ready to hang, all hardware included
